label: OpenAI Codex CLI

skills.note: Codex scans .agents/skills (NOT .codex/skills). The same tree is read by Gemini CLI and Cursor, so one directory serves three tools.

agents._model_note: Deliberately NOT emitted: the codex agent manifest is TOML with name/description only in the driven shape, and no model field has been verified against the live tool. A key invented here would be a guess that parses wrong or silently does nothing — say the gap instead.

trust_note: Codex requires you to trust a command hook before it runs, and re-arms that gate whenever the hook's definition changes. Run /hooks in Codex and approve DAW's, or the pipeline is advisory only.
